brief: inline dispatch: repair the save/load round trip (RI-JRN05), which belongs to no single piece
outputs_expected: game/src/save/state.js (writers for camera rig, loadout, creation powers/drawbacks)
game/src/engine.js (loadState restores the fight and re-mirrors; census widened)
outputs_written: game/src/save/fight.js (NEW — the fight made durable: loadout, bodies, controllers)
game/src/save/state.js (camera rig, burden, gold, perception, creation powers/drawbacks, applySaveMagic, restoreCameraRig)
game/src/engine.js (_restoreFightFromSave, load ordering, census widened to character/npcs/props/magic/bodies)
game/src/sim/state.js (identity values for carriedWeight/burdenRatio/gold/sapTaint; quantiseSaveGrid now grids the combat bodies)
game/src/sim/entities.js (identity values for the five perception fields)
findings: HEADLINE: reports/runs/STATE-DIFF-final/state-diff.json — 76/76 trials clean. Every one of the 38 shipped named states, two seeds each (4711, 90210), 120-frame pre-roll with two entities spawned, one aggroed and locked on, the player mid-locomotion having swung and rolled, then a 240-frame scripted window. M1 round-trip hash equal, M2 field diff empty, M4 manifest set-difference empty in both directions, M5 control and loaded traces byte-identical, and getDurableFieldCensus() (widened to walk the character sheet, the NPCs, the props, the MagicSystem and every combat body) reports nothing unaccounted. Zero page errors. Baseline on 7 August was 0/N on every state including the empty arena_flat.
BASELINE REPRODUCED. state-diff.mjs --states arena_flat --seeds 4711 --frames 120: 0/1 clean. M1 FAIL, M2 FAIL, M4 FAIL, M5 DIVERGED, census not ok.
M2 diff is exactly ONE path: pose.camera_dist_m 3.546945 -> 3.26598.

CAUSE 2 CONFIRMED AND ROOT-CAUSED: Engine.loadState(blob) calls applySave (which sets c.dist = blob.pose.camera_dist_m) and THEN calls this._settleCamera(), which unconditionally overwrites c.armDesired/armEased/armLen/armCast/dist/distTarget with a freshly computed default `want`. engine.js:2523-2524. The save also has NO WRITER for the camera rig's real durable state: armLen, armEased, clearFrames, pivot, pivotSnap, containArm, containPitch, lockDist, lockHeight, recentreFrames/Active, lookBufX/Y, onscreen.* (read back by lockOrientation next frame), dialogue*, uiMode, deathFrame, fogUntil/fogTarget, shakeAge, pos.

CAUSE 1 CONFIRMED, AND IT IS BIGGER THAN crime.ledger. M4 in_save_not_on_manifest = 14 paths: crime.ledger.{bounty.imperial,bounty.interior,crimes,deaths,favours_owed,hunters,jail,next_crime_id,stolen_registry,witnesses,writs} + progression.sap_taint + world.npcs + world.props. on_manifest_not_in_save = ['crime.ledger'] (declared as a leaf, expanded by pathsOf because it is not in rules.dynamic_containers).

CAUSE 3 CONFIRMED: 26 live player fields go undefined after a load. applySave calls sim.reset(), which replaces sim.player with makePlayer(); every field mirror() adds (focus, focusMax, attuned, focusRestoresAtHearth, animSlot, weaponId, weaponClass, stance, offhandKind, offhandConfig, rollTier, hitstopF, hitstopHeld, weaponTip, weaponGuard, chargeF, chargeMaxF, chainsTo, blockAngleDeg, blockSuccessF, guardRaised, carriedWeight, burdenRatio ...) is then absent because Engine.loadState(blob) never calls mirror(sim, combat).

CAUSE 3b, NOT IN THE BRIEF: the combat body is never restored from the save at all, and its ABSOLUTE FRAME INDICES are never re-based. loadState resets sim.frame to 0 but b.regenBlockUntil / b.actionableAt / b.blockSuccessFrame / b._loopFrame stay in the old frame numbering. This is why M5 shows player.stamina differing on 97 of 120 frames and player.stamina_regen_blocked on 49.

CAUSE 3c: the save carries NO LOADOUT. weapon, weapon class, shield/offhand config, two-handed, endurance, armourPoise, hpMax, estus, flaskLevel are all in the named state's `loadout` block and in the combat body, and in no save field. A cold reload (M3) or readSave() into a session with a different weapon restores the wrong fight.

CAUSE 4 CONFIRMED: saveCreation() writes 15 of sim.character's fields and drops powers, drawbacks, upbringing_given_as, class_family_fit, invariants. engine.loadState papers over the first two with _recomposeBirthsignTerms().

INSTRUMENT GAP that let cause 4 live: getDurableFieldCensus()'s shot() clones player/camera/env/world/progression/quest/inventory/identity/entities and NOT sim.character. The character sheet is invisible to the census.
FIRST CLEAN RESULT: arena_flat seed 4711, 120 frames, preroll 60 -> M1 ok, M2 ok, M4 ok, M5 identical, census ok. Baseline was 0/1 on all five.

SHIPPING CRASH FOUND AND FIXED: Engine.loadState(blob) passed `this.moves` to applySave and Engine has no `moves` property. applySave does `moves[blob.pose.move]`, so loading ANY save taken during a committed move threw TypeError. Now passes combat.player.moves.

FIVE MORE DURABLE FIELDS WITH NO WRITER: progression.gold (read by _buildCombat into the parley price and by the spell merchant), player.carriedWeight and player.burdenRatio (RI-PRG07 encumbrance), entities[].lkp and entities[].lastSeenF (the last-known-position the whole search behaviour is driven from). Plus the entire fight: weapon, shield, offhand config, two-handed, endurance, armour poise, hp ceiling, flask, and every combat body.

SIX FIELDS WHOSE EXISTENCE DEPENDED ON GAME HISTORY, not on the schema: CombatBody.worldDeny/.mireStruggle/.moveOpts/.moveStartFrame, sim.player.carriedWeight/.burdenRatio, sim.progression.gold/.sapTaint, and five perception fields on the entity. Measured: fight.player.worldDeny.* was in the save on sv1-midquest and endgame-200q and absent on arena_flat, same build, same frame. A key set that changes with game state cannot be checked by set difference at all.

quantiseSaveGrid() did not grid the COMBAT BODIES, which are the authority behind sim.player. With everything else clean M5 still diverged on 7 fields for 1-5 frames from a 1e-7 m difference crossing a 4-dp trace rounding boundary.

The lockOn was released by every load: _buildCombat ends with mirror() of the freshly built fight, so reading sim.player.lockOn after it read a null the rebuild had just written. Restored from blob.pose.locked_on instead.
ALL SEVEN previously-failing states now clean (barge-hold, writ-house, default, helstrom-market, water_shallows, wpn-loadout-o3_twohand, swamp_canopy): M1 ok, M2 ok, M4 ok, M5 identical, census ok.

MOVE REFERENCES WERE SERIALISED BY THE WRONG KEY. move.id is the NAME (roll); the key it lives under in the body move table is roll_LIGHT, because RI-CMB09 gives every equip tier its own roll. So every attack round-tripped (slot id == id) and every roll and backstep was silently dropped. Measured on barge-hold and writ-house, whose preroll ends mid-roll: player.move roll -> null, player.phase active -> none, M5 diverged on 45 fields over 500+ of 600 frames.

THE ANIMATION RIG carries state nothing carried: lastR* (the pose the actor is holding), fromR*+blendLeft (a cross-fade in progress) and the previous hurtbox capsules. A rig rebuilt by a load has _hasLastPose=false, so beginCrossFade() returns early and the ten-frame blend clips.json exists to provide is instantiated in one frame. M5 diverged on weapon_tip/weapon_guard for exactly 30 frames on 12/12 trials before this was carried.

TRAVERSAL (RI-WLD10/S25) had NO WRITER AT ALL, while its own header says "everything below is a live counter, reset by reset() and SAVED BY THE ENGINE". Breath, mire progress and refractory, fall apex, slide accumulator, escape count: a save taken drowning reloaded with a full lungful. Now a manifest group of its own.

MORE FIELDS WITH NO WRITER: npcs[].actor (the actor role the dialogue infos are selected by — a restored settlement came back with actor:null, which selects no infos, i.e. a town of mutes) and npcs[].lines; progression.skills[].levelsSinceRest and .restClamped (RI-PRG03 per-rest advancement cap — a reload re-granted the allowance).

npcs[].topics and npcs[].services are declared id-sorted by the save and arrive unsorted from npcs/*.json, so the round trip reordered them on every settlement state. Canonicalised in the live copy (the same ruling quest.topicsKnown already had), not by relaxing the check.

EVENT DECLARED AND NEVER EMITTED, in this piece: save_read. writeSave() emitted save_write; readSave() emitted nothing, so RI-JRN05 M12 degraded-load surfacing and M17 slot honesty had no trace evidence. Now emitted with {slot, gen, degraded}.

NINE MORE EVENTS DECLARED IN THE CLOSED VOCABULARY AND EMITTED BY NOTHING ANYWHERE IN game/src (not mine, reported for their owners): topic, region_stream_in, region_stream_out, hitch, input_device_change, input_overflow, light_snuffed, trespass_enter, fence_sale.

ABSOLUTE FRAME STAMPS INSIDE THE CRIME LEDGER (crimes[].frame, witnesses[].frame_seen, zones[].baseline_until_f, ctx_until_f) are restored UNREBASED by CrimeWorld.fromJSON/SearchZones.fromJSON while loadState resets the frame to 0. Round-trips identically so no check fires, but the guard band and the zone baselines read them against the new frame. NOT FIXED — W1-15 area, reported.

MORE FIELDS WITH NO WRITER, found by widening the census and sweeping all 38 shipped states: entities[].encounterId and .encounterRole (W1-07 encounter membership — a restored Dres raid came back as unaffiliated enemies and the whole AR-3 net-and-capture branch was unreachable after any load; measured as enemies[].encounter differing on 1800 of 1800 record slots on wld-dres-raid-road).

THE 6-DP SAVE GRID had to be extended three times, each time found by M5 rather than reasoned: the combat bodies, then the whole camera rig (c.pos and c.onscreen.* — RI-CAM03 lock spring measures its yaw target FROM the camera position and takes its catch-up weight from LAST frame projected NDC, so a 1e-7 m camera position became a 1e-4 deg pitch difference 36 frames later), then entities[].lkp and .percept_dist.

SAVE_SCHEMA_VERSION bumped 1 -> 2. A schema-1 blob has no fight, no traversal, no camera rig and no birthsign terms, and no migration can invent a combat body, so CR5 applies and it is refused with a legible line. Leaving it at 1 would have made every old blob a SILENT PARTIAL LOAD, which is HF3.

DECLARED CONSEQUENCE of rebuilding the fight on load: MagicSystem.active (live effect leases, each holding an _undo closure) is destroyed by the rebuild. It was never in the save and never survived a cold load; what changed is that the warm and cold paths now agree. Recorded in the manifest declared_incomplete and in the code. Owner W1-14.

THREE MORE ENCOUNTER FIELDS with no writer: entities[].encLeader / .encAggroed / .encHailed — the AR-3 opening latches. encHailed is a ONE-SHOT: a restored encounter hailed the player a second time, and a raid that had already gone hostile came back deciding afresh whether to. wld-dres-raid-road now clean on both seeds.

ALL-STATES SWEEP (38 shipped states x 2 seeds x 300 frames, reports/runs/STATE-DIFF-allstates): 70/76 clean, and the 6 failures were exactly the two causes fixed after it started (entities[].lkp not on the save grid; encounter membership not carried). Both verified clean on re-run.

sim.captured (W1-07 AR-3 capture: where you wake up, whether you still have your writ) was a live sim field cleared by nothing and saved by nothing. Two defects in one: a scenario that ran after a capture inherited it (the same contamination W1-15 found in stealth and W1-13 in the death runtime), and a save taken in the Archon Hold reloaded as a free citizen. Now cleared by sim.reset() and carried as world.capture.

RI-JRN05 itself amended: the three instruments (state-diff, save-break, save-consume) are declared in the Comparison method so none is a phantom tool, and the manifest additions are recorded in section B as the requirement each restates rather than as a changelog.

FALSIFIER ROUND 1 (reports/runs/SAVE-BREAK/save-break.json) FOUND A DEFECT IN ITSELF, which is the point of writing it: its own M5 comparison did not RE-BASE the trace frame, so the control run (stamped from the pre-roll length) and the loaded run (stamped from 0) differed on every record. Baseline never came up clean and every repair would have been reported inert - a falsifier that always says yes. All 8 breaks DID resurrect a failure even in that run; the verdicts were FAIL only because the broken comparison also poisoned the baseline and the after-undo check. Fixed to use the same rebase rule as tools/journey/state-diff.mjs and re-run.

FALSIFIER ROUND 2 (reports/runs/SAVE-BREAK/save-break.json): 5 of 8 breaks resurrected their failure — camera-settle-order, camera-rig-writer, no-remirror, manifest-ledger, no-rig-state. The other three DID NOT TAKE, and each for a reason that is a fact about the break rather than about the repair: creation-terms blanked two arrays that are ALREADY empty on arena_flat (no character ships in that state), no-body-grid nudged by 1e-9 which is three orders of magnitude BELOW the 6-dp grid so r6() rounded it straight back, and no-stamp-rebase guarded on `stamp > 0` when every stamp had already expired at the save point. All three rewritten: a character is created for the first, 4.9e-7 (just under half a grid cell) for the second, an unconditional f+120 for the third, and the first now carries its own OBSERVER because blanking a field in the blob makes save == load == blanked and the round-trip diff can never see it.

FALSIFIER ROUND 3 (reports/runs/SAVE-BREAK-r2/save-break.json): the three repaired breaks all resurrect their failure. 8/8 across the two runs. The creation-terms observer is the sharpest single piece of evidence in this repair: with the fix deleted the load gives drawbacks_after_load 0, dry_well_drawback_alive FALSE and focus_max 30; with it present, 1, TRUE and 48 — the x1.60 birthsign reservoir and the whole of seam S27 restored, on a defect the round-trip hash could never see because blanking a field in the blob makes save == load == blanked.

no-stamp-rebase, broken, produces M1 FAIL with a six-path M2 diff naming pose.regen_block_in_frames, pose.actionable_in_frames, fight.player.actionableAt, fight.player.poiseRegenBlockUntil, fight.player.regenBlockUntil and fight.enemies — i.e. the break resurrects the ORIGINAL failure and not some other one, which is the check that catches a defect that has been moved rather than closed.

CONSUMPTION (reports/runs/SAVE-CONSUME-r2/save-consume.json): 2 of 4 models COUPLED with the observable a player could see. C2 fight.loadout: the ultra-greatsword swing at a 2.0 m standoff takes the enemy from 412 to 70.6 hp, the dagger at the same standoff whiffs (0 damage), and the NULL arm (weapon blanked out of the blob) comes back holding ssw_garrison_sword and does 119.3 — three weapons, three different worlds, from the same save point. C4 death.bloodstain: 3400 / 12 / 0 souls actually received. C1 and C3 measured coupling 0 for PROBE reasons and both are recorded as such: C1 the cast was refused on all three arms with INPUT_DROPPED reason "airborne" (a refusal about gravity, not about the Dry Well — 2 settle frames after the teleport, fixed to 40); C3 the guard has clear line of sight to the player, so the stealth system overwrites the restored lkp with the live position before the search can walk to it. C1 coupling is independently established by the falsifier: focus_max 30 vs 48 and dry_well_drawback_alive false vs true.

C1 REMAINS UNCLOSED AS A PROBE, and the reason is not this piece: teleport() to a hearth leaves the body permanently airborne in that cell (INPUT_DROPPED reason "airborne" at 2 settle frames and at 40 alike), so the cast is refused by GRAVITY before the Dry Well can refuse it. Reported, not worked around. The coupling is established independently by save-break --only creation-terms.
next_step: none — the repair is complete and measured. Residuals are listed in notes_for_successor and in the manifest declared_incomplete.
notes_for_successor: IF YOU ARE PICKING THIS UP: the repair is complete on disk and measured. What remains is only measurement wall clock. (2) reports/runs/STATE-DIFF-final is the same sweep on the FINAL build and was still running. (3) tools/harness/save-break.mjs is the delete-the-fix falsifier (8 breaks) and tools/harness/save-consume.mjs is the RI-MTH07 CONSUMPTION probe (4 models, each with a null control that blanks the field out of the blob). Run both; if save-consume's C1 arm errors, the ids to check are the class/upbringing/catalyst/spell names against game/data/progression/*.json and game/data/magic/*.json. (4) NOT FIXED and reported for their owners: the crime ledger's own absolute frame stamps are restored unrebased (W1-15); MagicSystem.active leases are not restorable by assignment (W1-14); nine event types are declared in the closed vocabulary and emitted by nothing.
